theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have hreplace (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then y j else x j) =
        digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num, hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then y j else x j) * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) =
          ∑ j : Fin 9, (x j * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1 +
            (if j = i then y j - x j else 0) * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [hji] <;> ring
      _ = (∑ j : Fin 9, x j * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) +
          (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp
  have hde : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d := by
    intro i
    have hi := ((hrelation d e).mp h.1).2 i
    rw [hreplace d e i] at hi
    simpa [add_comm] using hi
  have hef : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num e := by
    intro i
    have hi := ((hrelation e f).mp h.2).2 i
    rw [hreplace e f i] at hi
    simpa [add_comm] using hi
  have hdiff : digits_to_num e = digits_to_num d +
      ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num, hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin 9, e i * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1) =
          ∑ i : Fin 9, (d i * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi
        ring
      _ = (∑ i : Fin 9, d i * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1) +
          ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := Finset.sum_add_distrib
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have hs : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9,
        ((e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d) :=
      Finset.dvd_sum (fun i hi => hde i)
    have hs' : (∑ i : Fin 9,
        ((e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d)) =
        (∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1) +
          9 * digits_to_num d := by
      rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
      simp
    rw [hs'] at hs
    have hm : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d := ⟨digits_to_num d, rfl⟩
    have hs'' := dvd_sub hs hm
    have heq : digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d =
        ((∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1) +
          9 * digits_to_num d) - 7 * digits_to_num d := by
      rw [hdiff]
      ring
    rw [heq]
    exact hs''
  have hprod : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    have h₁ : 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 - digits_to_num d := by
      have := dvd_sub (hef i) hsum
      convert this using 1 <;> ring
    have h₂ : 7 ∣ (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d := hde i
    have := dvd_add h₁ h₂
    convert this using 1 <;> ring
  intro i
  have hdiv : 7 ∣ f i - d i := by
    have hp : (7 : ℕ).Prime := by norm_num
    have hpow : ¬ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
      intro hx
      have hn : (7 : ℕ) ∣ (10 : ℕ) ^ i.1 := by norm_cast at hx ⊢
      have : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hn
      norm_num at this
    have hfactor : (7 : ℤ) ∣ f i - d i ∨ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 :=
      (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr (by norm_num : (7 : ℕ).Prime)).dvd_mul.mp (hprod i)
    rcases hfactor with hfactor | hfactor
    · exact hfactor
    · exact False.elim (hpow hfactor)
  have := dvd_neg.mpr hdiv
  simpa [sub_eq_add_neg] using this

  intro d e f h
  have hreplace (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then y j else x j) =
        digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then y j else x j) * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) =
          ∑ j : Fin 9, (x j * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1 +
            (if j = i then y j - x j else 0) * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp [hji] <;> ring
      _ = (∑ j : Fin 9, x j * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) +
          (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp

    intro i
    have hi := ((hrelation d e).mp h.1).2 i
    rw [hreplace d e i] at hi
    simpa [add_comm] using hi
  have hef : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - e i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num e := by
    intro i
    have hi := ((hrelation e f).mp h.2).2 i
    rw [hreplace e f i] at hi
    simpa [add_comm] using hi
  have hdiff : digits_to_num e = digits_to_num d +
      ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ i : Fin 9, e i * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1) =
          ∑ i : Fin 9, (d i * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro i hi

theorem putnam_1995_a3
(relation : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → (Fin 9 → ℤ) → Prop)
(digits_to_num : (Fin 9 → ℤ) → ℤ)
(hdigits_to_num : digits_to_num = fun dig => ∑ i : Fin 9, (dig i) * 10^i.1)
(hrelation : ∀ d e : (Fin 9 → ℤ), relation d e ↔ (∀ i : Fin 9, d i < 10 ∧ d i ≥ 0 ∧ e i < 10 ∧ e i ≥ 0) ∧ (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then e j else d j))))
: ∀ d e f : (Fin 9 → ℤ), ((relation d e) ∧ (relation e f)) → (∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ d i - f i) := by
  intro d e f h
  have hreplace (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (i : Fin 9) :
      digits_to_num (fun j : Fin 9 => if j = i then y j else x j) =
        digits_to_num x + (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    calc
      (∑ j : Fin 9, (if j = i then y j else x j) * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) =
          ∑ j : Fin 9, (x j * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1 +
            (if j = i then y j - x j else 0) * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) := by
        apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
        intro j hj
        by_cases hji : j = i <;> simp only [hji, ↓reduceIte] <;> ring
      _ = (∑ j : Fin 9, x j * (10 : ℤ) ^ j.1) +
          (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
        rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib]
        simp only [ite_mul, zero_mul, Finset.sum_ite_eq', Finset.mem_univ, ↓reduceIte]
  have hrel_dvd (x y : Fin 9 → ℤ) (hr : relation x y) :
      ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (y i - x i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num x := by
    intro i
    simpa only [hreplace, add_comm] using ((hrelation x y).mp hr).2 i
  have hde := hrel_dvd d e h.1
  have hef := hrel_dvd e f h.2
  have hdiff : digits_to_num e = digits_to_num d +
      ∑ i : Fin 9, (e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    rw [hdigits_to_num]
    rw [← Finset.sum_add_distrib]
    apply Finset.sum_congr rfl
    intro i hi
    ring
  have hsum : 7 ∣ digits_to_num e + digits_to_num d := by
    have hs : 7 ∣ ∑ i : Fin 9,
        ((e i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 + digits_to_num d) :=
      Finset.dvd_sum (fun i hi => hde i)
    rw [Finset.sum_add_distrib] at hs
    simp only [Finset.sum_const, Finset.card_univ, Fintype.card_fin,
      Int.nsmul_eq_mul, Nat.cast_ofNat] at hs
    have hm : 7 ∣ 7 * digits_to_num d := ⟨digits_to_num d, rfl⟩
    rw [hdiff]
    convert dvd_sub hs hm using 1 <;> ring
  have hprod : ∀ i : Fin 9, 7 ∣ (f i - d i) * (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
    intro i
    convert dvd_add (dvd_sub (hef i) hsum) (hde i) using 1 <;> ring
  intro i
  have hdiv : 7 ∣ f i - d i := by
    have hp : (7 : ℕ).Prime := by norm_num
    have hpow : ¬ (7 : ℤ) ∣ (10 : ℤ) ^ i.1 := by
      intro hx
      norm_cast at hx
      have : (7 : ℕ) ∣ 10 := hp.dvd_of_dvd_pow hx
      norm_num at this
    rcases (Int.prime_iff_natAbs_prime.mpr
      (by norm_num : Nat.Prime (Int.natAbs (7 : ℤ)))).dvd_mul.mp (hprod i) with hfactor | hfactor
    · exact hfactor
    · exact False.elim (hpow hfactor)
  simpa only [sub_eq_add_neg, neg_add_rev, neg_neg, add_comm] using dvd_neg.mpr hdiv
